name: Nova Medical Inc

about:
Nova Medical Inc. is headquartered in Wilmington, Massachusetts. The company originated from Dr. Patrick Ledden’s five years of experience designing and building custom radiofrequency (RF) coils for Massachusetts General Hospital. No founding year or ownership structure is publicly disclosed.

The firm specializes in engineering and manufacturing medium- and high-field RF coils for magnetic resonance imaging, including head coils and custom configurations. Its roughly 10,000-square-foot facility contains a dedicated RF laboratory, design workstations running AutoCAD and SolidWorks, and 3D printing equipment for prototyping and production. Employee count and annual output are not disclosed.

Nova Medical serves the medical imaging sector, supplying coils to hospitals and research institutions. Its earliest customer, Massachusetts General Hospital, exemplifies the academic medical centers that rely on its custom coil solutions for advanced MRI research and clinical applications.

The company was established to translate Dr. Ledden’s coil expertise into commercial products that address specific MR imaging challenges. It emphasizes in-house design, testing, and manufacturing to deliver high-quality coils tailored to each application.
